text: Why does this matter? If you were affected by a federal disaster, you might qualify for some tax relief. You may be entitled to a later filing deadline. Learn more here: IRS Tax Relief in Disaster Situations | H&R Block. If this applies to you, be sure to vist the Deductions section of the interview and select I had a casualty or theft loss. Provisions related to Qualified Federal Disaster Losses have been extended. The Federal Disaster Tax Relief Act of 2023 extended some special rules. Qualified federal disaster losses have been extended to include those declared by the President between Jan. 1, 2020 and Sep. 2, 2025 (previously Feb. 25, 2021). Your casualty event must have started between Dec. 28, 2019 and Jul. 4, 2025, and ended no later than Aug. 3, 2025.
